title: Concordia plan predicate v1
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement v1 with predicateType https://concordia.io/evidence/plan/v1: the binding of a Terraform or OpenTofu plan file to a revision and an environment. The subject is the sha256 digest of the plan file (`show -json` output); Concordia compares it with the file. The schema is open: Concordia ignores fields that it does not list and does not persist them.

revision.description: The source revision that the plan was made for. It must equal the evaluated revision.

time.description: When the plan was made. `assurance.plans[].maxAgeDays` counts from it.
